name: recipes-enrich
description: Drives the recipes corpus enrichment (#11, #59): pull recipes that still need a reading — of their ingredient lines, their method, their equipment, their nutrition, or when the dish is eaten — read them, and push the results back. The recipe-backend binary does all I/O; the skill does only the reading. No version field, so it tracks the repo it ships in — the skill stays in lockstep with the binary's contract.
